articles.detail: 5 cycles completed, avg 7/cycle (below typical 11-13 range; watch for sustained dip)

experiment: Evaluated 2026-04-21-multi-source-floors on schedule (evaluateAfter: 2026-04-24). Politics+economy combined multi-rate improved from 0.31 baseline to 0.336 over the experiment window (politics 0.39→0.41, economy 0.18→0.23). Overall multi-rate improved 0.22→0.239. Direction improved on all measures; no guardrail metric degraded >20%. Target of p+e ≥ 0.45 was not reached — feed supply (~9 multi-source stories/cycle) is the binding constraint. Keeping the hard-floor prompt change. No new experiment proposed: all targets met today.
weakestArea: Economy coverage was unusually thin at 5 articles today (15% share) against an economy selector floor of 3/cycle that should yield ≥15/day. This gap — combined with avg publish count of 7/cycle (below the 8 guardrail) — suggests selector floors may not be consistently honoured on today's feed. Worth monitoring across the next 2-3 cycles before intervening; if economy share stays below 20% by Apr 27, consider whether the floor needs reinforcing in the prompt.
watching: India-Pakistan tensions: Pakistan's airspace ban on India aviation through May 24 signals extended standoff; future de-escalation or escalation signals worth tracking.
Lebanon-Israel ceasefire: third week extension active; any breakdown or Salam government consolidation move would be high-impact.
Japan earthquake (7.7): megaquake advisory issued; aftershock risk and Nankai Trough watch ongoing.
Iran-US nuclear talks: sanctions enforcement and tanker movements through Strait of Hormuz remain active pressure points.
Gaza students / Rafah crossing: structural story on humanitarian access that may develop with international advocacy outcomes.
coverageGaps: Southeast Asia almost absent today (AS: 1 article) — Philippines, Vietnam, Indonesia trade and political stories underrepresented given regional significance.
Sub-Saharan Africa light at 4 articles despite active stories in Nigeria, Ethiopia, and Sudan conflict zone.
Economy category notably thin — no coverage of ongoing US-China tariff negotiations, European Central Bank signals, or commodity market moves despite Hormuz/oil being active.
context: Yesterday's cycle produced 12 duplicate articles (same source URL, two slugs) — the highest single-day duplicate count since the 7-day prefilter was introduced on Apr 19. The duplicates clustered around high-velocity stories (El Niño, Duterte ICC, Iran cyber, Lebanon ceasefire) where two writer instances independently picked the same source. Today's count is 0. No parameter change is needed, but the pattern suggests the writer stage occasionally races on breaking stories that arrive in both the Event Registry feed and the RSS standalone pool simultaneously.
